newsitem.title: INDIA: India will try to lower interest rates - Chidambaram.
newsitem.headline: India will try to lower interest rates - Chidambaram.

text.p: Indian Finance Minister P. Chidambaram said on Friday that the government would try to bring down interest rates.
A government stateme@arks to a parliamentary committee said the finance minister "stated that (the) government would endeavour to bring down interest rates".
Chidambaram said the "liquidity crunch had eased considerably and there were adequate reserves of foreign exchange for imports", the statement said.

"He (Chidambaram) also said that it was the regulated sector of industry that was showing sluggish growth and perhaps there was need to remove those regulations which hindered growth," the statement said.
